rv.q: The show has a sunny, optimistic spirit that is hard to resist, even when the material feels thin.
Youth isn't only for the young, at least not as a marketable commodity in popular entertainment.

Faithful readers will note that I’ve been doling out positive reviews left and right these days. That speaks to the general high quality of Broadway as of late; I cannot recall the last production I saw that wasn’t at least decent.

cn.t: Critics find this teen-focused musical a calculated attempt to capture the youth market, with modest results. The show struggles to distinguish itself in a crowded Broadway landscape of adolescent-themed productions.

vs.sum: The Bernard B. Jacobs Theatre offers excellent sightlines from most seats, though comfort is compromised by tight legroom, especially in the mezzanine. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its historic architecture and unique murals, but restroom facilities are limited, leading to long lines during intermission.

acc.note: 7 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Copper induction loop available.
